data.title: D · 新婚床榻的灵魂托付
data.description: 纯白新婚双人床上，半透明真丝睡袍滑落在旁。D紫眸中蓄满极乐与动情的泪水，十指深扣你的掌心，在极致温柔的颠簸中带着哭腔轻喘低喃：“我不是你的假妻子……我是你真正的妻子。”
data.location: intimate sunlit bedroom with billowing sheer curtains
data.action: tangled in white silk bedsheets, sheer white peignoir half open, violet eyes misted with tears of ecstasy and genuine love, whispering I am truly your wife
data.lighting: ethereal morning sunlight filtering through sheer billowing white curtains
data.mood: profound soul union, tearful true love confession, absolute bliss
data.promptProse: Tangled in white silk bedsheets with a sheer peignoir open, D sheds tears of ecstasy with deep purple eyes, whispering her true love vow.
data.animaCaption: D whispering her true love confession on a bridal bed in morning sunlight.
